meta.title: The desert treasure
meta.subtitle: You hear of a hidden treasure in a near desert called Goldwind Desert. Who knows what you will find?
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: The Desert road Intersection
scenes.narrative: You come across a road intersection.

scenes.title: The Long Walk
scenes.narrative:
You go left at the intersection and there is a very long road ahead. 

It goes by many tall sand dunes - you walk for a while and then you see a building with a ladder on the side.

choices.text: Climb the ladder on the building

scenes.title: The Building
scenes.narrative:
You climbed the ladder on the building, and you rest at the top where you see an open roof window. 

You spot an oasis in the distance.

choices.text: Enter the building through the roof window
Climb down the ladder on the building

scenes.title: The Research Discovery
scenes.narrative:
You enter the building. 

You see a room and a balcony you can't get to. 

You also see a map.

choices.text: Pick up the map and read it

scenes.title: The Ice Chamber
scenes.narrative:
You look around the building some more. 

You don't find much besides expired cans and boxes of food. 

You quickly get bored and see the map again.

choices.text: Pick up the map and read it

scenes.title: Map ending
scenes.narrative:
You pick up and read the map and it tells you where the treasure is. 

THE END.

scenes.title: Something Found
scenes.narrative:
You go through the roof window. 

You hop down on a balcony and see a room with a big chast in it. 

You enter the room and open the chest. 

The chest is full of gold and diamonds - this is the treasure. 

THE END.

scenes.title: The First Contact
scenes.narrative:
You leave the building with nothing. 

You are disapointed so you decide to go back home and report your findings to others. 

THE END

scenes.title: Death.
scenes.narrative:
You stumble upon a mangled creature that looks like an animatronic. 

You run away but the creature is too fast and it gets you. 

YOU DIED
